short_description: A quadruped hip abduction with a straight leg that targets the glutes and outer hips.
how_to: Start on all fours with your wrists under your shoulders.
Keep one leg straight and lift it out to the side.
Raise it until your hip is at its limit.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch sides.
correct: Move with a slow, controlled tempo.
Keep your supporting knee under your hip.
mistakes: Don't rotate your pelvis to gain height.

short_description: A standing chest and shoulder opener that releases tension by clasping the hands behind the back.
how_to: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Bring your arms behind you and clasp your fingers together.
Gently draw your shoulders back and down.
Hold the position and breathe steadily.
correct: Keep your chest open and lifted.
Keep your chin parallel to the floor.
Relax your shoulders away from your ears.
mistakes: Don't arch your lower back excessively.

short_description: A gentle face exercise that engages the muscles around the nose and mid-face.
how_to: Sit or stand comfortably with your spine tall.
Scrunch your nose upward as if trying to touch it with your upper lip.
Hold briefly, then release completely.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

short_description: A lying dumbbell curl that isolates the hamstrings by bending the knees against resistance.
how_to: Lie face down on a mat and grip a dumbbell between your feet.
Keep your hips pressed into the mat.
Curl your feet toward your glutes by bending your knees.
Lower the dumbbell slowly back to the start.
correct: Keep your hips on the mat throughout.
Control the weight on the way down.
Move through the full range of motion.
mistakes: Don't let your hips lift off the mat.
Don't drop the weight on the lowering phase.
Don't swing your legs for momentum.

short_description: A face exercise that works the cheek and lip muscles by combining a smile with a fish-face pucker.
how_to: Sit or stand with a tall spine.
Smile wide, then suck your cheeks inward at the same time.
Hold the expression for a few seconds.
Release fully and repeat.
correct: Keep your neck and shoulders relaxed.
Hold each rep for a moment before releasing.

short_description: A seated lateral stretch that lengthens the obliques and side of the torso.
how_to: Sit tall on the floor or a chair with your feet flat.
Raise one arm overhead.
Lean your torso to the opposite side until you feel a stretch.
Hold, then return to center and switch sides.
correct: Reach long through the raised hand.

short_description: A single-leg hip hinge with a dumbbell that builds hamstring strength and balance.
how_to: Stand on one foot holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Hinge at your hip and lower the dumbbell toward the floor.
Keep your back flat and your lifted leg extending behind you.
Drive through your standing heel to return to upright, then switch sides.
correct: Keep your hips square to the floor.
Keep a soft bend in your standing knee.

short_description: A lying overhead extension with dumbbells that isolates the triceps through a full range of motion.
how_to: Lie on your back holding dumbbells above your chest with arms extended.
Bend your elbows to lower the weights toward your forehead.
Keep your upper arms still and pointing upward.
Extend your arms back to the start position.
correct: Keep your upper arms vertical and still.
mistakes: Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't let the weights drop fast.

short_description: A supine neck strengthening exercise that works the deep flexors by lifting the head off the floor.
how_to: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Tuck your chin slightly toward your chest.
Slowly lift your head just off the floor.
Hold briefly, then lower with control.
correct: Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Keep your shoulders relaxed on the floor.
mistakes: Don't jerk your head up quickly.
Don't strain your jaw or face.
Don't lift your shoulders off the floor.

short_description: A face exercise that tones the cheek muscles by inflating and holding the cheeks with air.
how_to: Sit or stand with a tall, relaxed posture.
Close your lips and inhale through your nose.
Puff both cheeks out fully with the trapped air.
Hold for a few seconds, then exhale and release.
correct: Keep your lips sealed throughout the hold.
mistakes: Don't tense your neck or shoulders.

short_description: A shoulder rotation exercise with dumbbells that strengthens the rotator cuff and upper back.
how_to: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding dumbbells at your sides.
Raise your upper arms out to the sides until parallel to the floor.
Rotate your forearms upward so your hands point toward the ceiling.
Reverse the motion back to the start.
correct: Keep your upper arms parallel to the floor.
mistakes: Don't use weights that force you to swing.
Don't let your elbows drop below parallel.

short_description: A curl variation that brings the dumbbell across the body to target the brachialis and forearm muscles.
how_to: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing in.
Curl one dumbbell across your body toward the opposite shoulder.
Lower with control, then repeat on the other side.
Alternate arms for the desired reps.
correct: Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Keep your torso upright and still.
mistakes: Don't swing your torso for momentum.
Don't let your elbow drift forward.
Don't grip the handle too tightly.

short_description: A single-arm sit-up with a dumbbell pressed overhead that challenges the core and shoulder together.
how_to: Lie on your back with your knees bent and one dumbbell pressed above your chest.
Keep the dumbbell arm extended straight toward the ceiling.
Sit up by engaging your core, keeping the weight overhead.
Lower back slowly to the floor and repeat, then switch arms.
correct: Keep the dumbbell directly above your shoulder.
Move with a steady, controlled tempo.
Keep your free arm helping for balance only.
mistakes: Don't let the dumbbell drift forward.

short_description: A wide-grip curl with dumbbells that emphasizes the short head of the biceps.
how_to: Stand tall holding dumbbells with your elbows angled out slightly wider than your torso.
Keep your palms facing up.
Curl both dumbbells upward while keeping your upper arms still.
Lower slowly back to the start.
correct: Keep your elbows wide and stable.
mistakes: Don't let your elbows drop to your sides.
Don't use more weight than you can control.

short_description: An overhead triceps extension with a dumbbell that targets all three heads of the triceps.
how_to: Stand or sit tall holding one dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Keep your upper arms close to your head.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend your arms back to the start.
correct: Keep your upper arms still and vertical.
mistakes: Don't flare your elbows out wide.

short_description: A breathing face exercise that releases facial tension by opening the eyes wide and extending the tongue.
how_to: Sit comfortably with a tall spine.
Inhale through your nose.
Open your eyes wide, stretch your tongue out and downward.
Exhale forcefully with a 'ha' sound, then relax.
correct: Open your mouth fully during the exhale.
Breathe in deeply before each rep.
mistakes: Don't hold your breath at the top.
Don't do this in a way that strains your jaw.

short_description: A standing dumbbell punch that trains the shoulders and arms with a rhythmic pressing motion.
how_to: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding light dumbbells at shoulder height.
Punch one arm straight out in front at shoulder level.
Bring it back and alternate with the other arm.
Keep a steady rhythm throughout.
correct: Keep your wrists straight on each punch.
Control the return of each arm.
mistakes: Don't lock your elbow at full extension.
Don't use weights that compromise your control.
Don't lean back as you punch.

short_description: A face exercise that strengthens the muscles around the mouth by holding a wide smile.
how_to: Sit or stand with a relaxed, tall posture.
Stretch your lips into a wide smile without showing your teeth.
Hold the expression for a few seconds.
Release fully and repeat.
correct: Keep your neck and shoulders relaxed.
Hold each rep for a full count.

short_description: A face exercise that tones the cheeks by sucking them inward and holding the contraction.
how_to: Sit or stand comfortably with your spine tall.
Close your lips and suck your cheeks inward toward your back teeth.
Hold the hollow position for a few seconds.
Release and repeat for the desired reps.
mistakes: Don't tense your neck or shoulders.
Don't bite down on your cheeks.

short_description: A prone shoulder mobility drill that strengthens the lower traps and rotator cuff by sliding the arms along the floor.
how_to: Lie face down on the floor with your arms at your sides.
Press your forearms lightly into the floor.
Slide your arms overhead in a Y shape, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Slide them back down slowly and repeat.
mistakes: Don't let your elbows flare out past your ears.
